scope: Name origins from RU-PETROVSKY-SRLI for open names matched by spelling.
decision: User, 16 November 2026: the widget text must not mention dictionaries or a Russian origin; state the ultimate origin of the name only. If unsure, do not write it.
method: Transliteration match (var/namedays-research/petrovsky137.mjs), full entries (petro-entries138.mjs), base-name notes for “feminine of …” entries (petro-lookup138.mjs). Latin and Greek words corrected from OCR noise (feHx -> felix, tSresis -> tērēsis, eugen^s -> eugenēs).
